newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Two bombs explode in Algiers, at least 50 wounded.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs explode in Algiers, at least 50 wounded.

text.p: Two bombs exploded in rapid succession in Algiers on Sunday, wounding about 50 people and possibly killing five, witnesses said.
The bombs exploded just four days before Algeria holds general elections which the authorities hope will help end more than five years of bloodshed which they blame on Moslem fundamentalists.
One bomb ripped through a passenger bus in Algiers' Martyrs Square in the heart of the capital, wounding about 30 people, one witness told Reuters.
"Maybe five more were killed," he said, adding that this was what a policeman on the spot had told him.
The other bomb went off in Gharmoul Street, in another part of the city centre, wounding between 15 and 20 people, another witness said.
